title: John M NDE 8023
content: I came back to consciousness after the procedure because I couldn't breathe. I pushed the button for the nurse. I got out, 'I can't breathe.' Then everything went black and the big panic was on for the staff. I remember hearing the big doors slam, seeing the lights in the hallway, and then nothing, just blackness. Then I saw myself floating in a sea of very dark blackness. I felt total love, NO judgment, and no negativity at all. I heard the doctor talking to the interns about what to do. They had tried everything medical, but NOTHING worked because I did not want to come back. I had never felt SO loved, SO calm, NO pain, and NOTHING negative...NOTHING. Around me, it was completely flat black. I had NO fear of ANY kind. It was WONDERFUL and AMAZING. It felt like graduation day because I was finally free of this life and ready to move on. The doctor in charge asked what should be done to bring me back. A female voice said to put pressure on the nerves of the points of the jaw. That worked. I was SO angry that I had NO choice in the matter. I did NOT want to come back!!!

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reported seeing himself "floating in a sea of very dark blackness" and hearing the doctor talking to interns.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "female voice" suggested a medical intervention (pressure on jaw nerve points) that brought him back.

environment.environment_other_detail: A "sea of very dark blackness" / "completely flat black."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return occurred after a "female voice" advised applying pressure to jaw nerve points; "That worked."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: He regained consciousness after "the procedure" and then "couldn't breathe"; staff panicked and tried medical interventions.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reported blackness/void and hearing medical staff; no tunnel, light-being, relatives, life review, or boundary described.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He first perceived hospital events (doors, hallway lights), then "blackness," then floating in dark void with love/no judgment, then involuntary return due to medical intervention.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported a "female voice" giving a specific medical instruction (pressure on jaw nerve points) that enabled resuscitation, and stated "NOTHING worked because I did not want to come back."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I saw myself floating in a sea of very dark blackness." "I felt total love, NO judgment, and no negativity at all." "I did not want to come back."
